text:
deploy-bot: starting rollout v1.4.2 -> staging :rocket:
maria: saw a preflight fail on the smoke check for /api/infer, 500s in the canary logs
maria: logs snippet: `error: failed to decrypt SECRET_DB_URL: invalid base64 padding`
emily: hmm, staging secret looks wrapped but prod secret is showing up as plaintext base64 on the configmap print
lee: can you paste the kubectl output?
maria: `kubectl -n infra get secret redwood-db -o yaml`
maria: ```apiVersion: v1
data:
  DB_URL: VGVzdA==
metadata:
  name: redwood-db
```
emily: that's staging; prod output was `DB_URL: eyJrIjoi...` (looks like a kms-envelope)
raj: so staging is plain base64, prod is kms-envelope -> decryption path differs, env parity issue
lee: cause: our deploy pipeline step that runs `kubectl create secret` used different wrapper when regenerating in staging earlier this week
maria: we should hold the rollout, pin the image back to v1.4.1 until secrets are reconciled
raj: agreed. Maria, add a short release note & rollback reason so support has context?
maria: done. `Release hold: staging->prod blocked: secret encoding mismatch; rolling back canary to v1.4.1`
oncall-bot: incident annotated: env-parity-secret-encoding-1932104567, priority: low
emily: quick test: tried `echo VGVzdA== | base64 -d` outputs `Test` while prod envelope returns an error without kms unwrap
lee: ops plan: (1) stop prod canary, (2) pin route to v1.4.1, (3) reconcile staging secret format to use KMS envelope, (4) re-run preflight
raj: who owns the KMS unwrap automation? @emily?
emily: I can own reconciliation. I'll regenerate the staging secret using the same kms-wrap pipeline and push to staging in the change window (in 45m).
maria: change window noted. Do we need an SAE for customer-facing impact? It's only canary, not full prod yet
raj: no SAE. Communicate on #support that release is paused and why, include action items
maria: pinged #support with rollback note and pointer to this thread
lee: after reconciliation, we should add a parity smoke test that compares secret encoding metadata between envs before promoting
emily: adding a CI check ticket: CI-4573 parity smoke: secret encoding header check
raj: also ensure deploybot has a preflight that aborts on `invalid base64` decryption failures (deploybot currently only looks at 502/5xx thresholds)
lee: +1. Can we also add a flag to pin deploys when `--force` not used? prevent accidental overwrite of secret types
maria: rolling back now to v1.4.1 for the canary. deploy-bot: initiate rollback
deploy-bot: rollback started: v1.4.1 -> prod-canary :white_check_mark:
emaria: thanks team. post-mortem: short note in #postmortems after we close the loop on CI-4573 and reconciliation steps
raj: closing timeline: hold placed, canary rolled back, owner assigned (emily) to reconcile, follow-ups: CI-4573, deploybot preflight enhancement
emaria: tagging this thread in the release notes doc and marking release status: halted
lee: tl;dr: rollout paused due to staging/prod secret encoding mismatch; canary rolled back; owner assigned to reconcile and add parity checks
end
